skills.name: React
skills.short_definition: JavaScript library for building component-based user interfaces.
skills.recruiter_explanation: A common frontend requirement, frequently paired with JavaScript or TypeScript, state management, and modern web tooling.

skills.name: Node.js
skills.short_definition: Server-side JavaScript runtime built on the V8 engine.
skills.recruiter_explanation: Common for backend and full-stack JavaScript roles, often paired with TypeScript, REST APIs, and cloud services.

skills.name: Spring Boot
skills.short_definition: Java framework for building production-ready web services and applications.
skills.recruiter_explanation: A core backend skill for Java developers, commonly paired with microservices, REST APIs, SQL databases, and cloud platforms.

skills.name: PostgreSQL
skills.short_definition: Open-source relational database known for standards compliance and extensibility.
skills.recruiter_explanation: Requested across backend, data, and platform roles where production SQL and relational data modeling matter.

skills.name: AWS
skills.short_definition: Amazon Web Services cloud platform for compute, storage, networking, data, and managed services.
skills.recruiter_explanation: Broad cloud experience signal; confirm which AWS services and whether the role expects architecture, development, operations, or security depth.

skills.name: Docker
skills.short_definition: Platform and tooling for packaging and running applications in containers.
skills.recruiter_explanation: Common across software, DevOps, and platform roles and frequently paired with Kubernetes and CI/CD.

skills.name: Kubernetes
skills.short_definition: Container orchestration platform for deploying, scaling, and operating containerized applications.
skills.recruiter_explanation: Common in DevOps, SRE, cloud, and platform roles; often requested with Docker, Helm, Terraform, and a cloud provider.

skills.name: Kafka
skills.short_definition: Distributed event-streaming platform for high-throughput data pipelines and real-time applications.
skills.recruiter_explanation: Often required in backend and data roles involving event-driven architecture, messaging, and streaming systems.
